name: u16_remask
question: Does explicitly reapplying a 16-bit mask after narrowing change b210's generated code?

variants.name: single_mask
variants.intent: Mask the input to 16 bits once and reuse the narrowed value.

variants.name: redundant_remask
variants.intent: Reapply the equivalent 16-bit mask at each use of the already narrowed value.
